reference.source: Volkswagen Newsroom 'New Golf GTI - International Press Presentation' (162 kW/220 PS from 4500 to 6200 rpm, 350 N·m from 1500 to 4400 rpm); australiancar.reviews EA888 Gen3 (82.5 x 92.8 mm, 1984 cc, 9.6:1, firing order 1-3-4-2, IHI turbo); mahle.com piston data (rod length 144 mm); dailydriven.ro (oil capacity 5.7 L Gen3)
reference.notes: Power is a plateau from 4500 to 6200 rpm; 5500 rpm is stored as the representative peak. Torque is a plateau from 1500 to 4400 rpm, 1500 rpm is stored. OEM turbo values are estimates. The 0.5 bar boost target is the highest value without knock in this model on 98 RON (sources quote about 1.3 bar peak boost without stating gauge or absolute), so the calibration factor also absorbs boost-model error. Redline 6500 rpm and limiter 6800 rpm are estimates.
